# Wharf 0.8.0 changes

- Added the `Wharf.Copilot` adapter boundary and typed invocation contracts.
- Added exact requested/effective CLI version validation.
- Added native and normalized frontier effort recording.
- Added environment, file, and stdin credential source handling without
  embedding credential values in arguments, environment values, or redacted
  commands.
- Added HTTPS endpoint allowlisting and subagent model metadata.
- Added a process version probe and fake-probe contract tests.
